p: ox: Either a great beast of the herd, or a small beast of the flock.
breaking up: Breaking a house to enter in, or undermining.
blood shed for him: He shall be put to death that kills him.
put his hand unto his neighbour's: That is, whether he has stolen.
Then shall an oath of the: They should swear by the name of the Lord.
it for witness: He shall show some part of the beast or bring in witnesses.
came for his hire: He that hired it shall be free by paying the hire.
wives shall be widows: The just plague of God on the oppressors.
crieth unto me: For cold and necessity.
first of thy ripe fruits: Your abundance of your corn.
to the dogs: And so have nothing to do with it.
